summary.intent: Execute all plans in GSD phase 68.1 (web client runtime integration) via wave-based parallel subagent execution, then plan and execute gap-closure waves to close verification gaps until the phase's e2e suite and success criteria pass.
summary.outcome: All 14 original plans plus 8 gap-closure plans executed across multiple waves with real bugs found and fixed (folder id desync, kind-cache wiring, IPNS durability enrollment, text-editor decrypt key bug, D-05 toast routing), reducing e2e failures from 17→13→8 out of 208 specs; however round-2 verification still reported gaps_found (3/5 criteria), the session hit its usage quota mid-execution requiring manual recovery of uncommitted work, and the phase remains incomplete pending further gap closure.

repo: mock-ipns-routing (dev delegated routing) stores IPNS records in an in-memory Map — wiped on every container restart; only records with a DB row (persisted at publish time via the API) survive, so restarting the container during dev manufactures false 'propagation timeout' failures.
mock-ipns-routing's Docker healthcheck used `wget localhost`, which busybox resolves to `::1`, but the app binds IPv4-only — perpetually unhealthy; fixed by pinning the healthcheck to 127.0.0.1.
API runs on :3000; :3001 is the mock-ipns-routing delegated-routing service, not the API — probing 3001 for API health silently hits the wrong service.

createFolder previously published subfolder IPNS records without encryptedIpnsPrivateKey/keyEpoch, so nothing enrolled in ipns_republish_schedule — a real production durability gap where subfolder records would die at the 48h IPNS TTL.

The decision-coverage gate's informational-tag parser only recognizes the tag inside the bold ID group, e.g. `- **D-04 [informational]:**` — placing it after the bold group silently fails to register.

Migration 1750000000000-ApiSchemaCutover dropped the shares table's plaintext item_name column entirely (not renamed); share.service.ts now hardcodes itemName: '', making the REQ-4 name-backfill feature permanently dead code — reviving it would require server-side plaintext name storage, which the project's zero-knowledge rule forbids.

The live /shares REST API grants an entire subtree via one ECIES wrap of the root readKey; there is no per-child key field, so collectChildKeys/ChildKeyDto (the original plan's design) has no live caller — UI code calls resolveChildNodeIdentity directly instead.

sdk-core's issueReadGrant/claimInvite produce base64 payloads but the live share/invite DTOs are hex-only — web code bypasses sdk-core's grant primitives and calls wrapKey/unwrapKey directly with hex encoding.

client.downloadFromIpns fed the parent folder's key into sdk-core's resolveFileMetadata instead of the file's own readKey (both are Uint8Array so the type system didn't catch it) — broke the text editor and version-history decrypt paths; preview/download used a different, correct path so were unaffected.

code.finding: Hardcoded isFolder = true meant the D-02 kind cache populated in 68.1-14 was never consulted in the shared browser — files rendered as folders; fixed in gap plan 68.1-15.

workflow: Background subagent 'completion' notifications can be lost when the agent parks itself waiting on a long-running background shell (e.g. the 208-spec Playwright suite) — happened twice with the exit-gate agent. Mitigate with an independent watchdog polling for a completion artifact (.last-run.json) and resuming the agent via SendMessage the moment it lands, rather than trusting the task-notification alone.

The full web-e2e suite is `describe.serial` — one failure early in a spec file aborts all subsequent tests in that file, so raw fail counts understate true breakage; a spec 'passing' at 190/208 can still mean most nested-content-dependent coverage never executed.

Worktree-executing subagents can misreport their own `expected_base` in worktree_metadata (returning their own HEAD/docs commit instead of the true fork point) — verify the actual merge-base via git before recording it in the wave manifest.
Never run full test suites concurrently from parallel subagents — reconfirmed from prior memory during this session's wave gating.

friction: Wave 1 executor stalled mid-stream after 119 tool calls (~23 min); orchestrator had to spot-check filesystem/git state and resume it manually.
Exit-gate agent lost its wake-up signal twice after launching the long-running e2e suite in the background, requiring manual liveness checks and SendMessage-based resumption.
Transient git index.lock during Wave 3 tracking commit required a liveness check and retry.
A Bash command was denied (likely attempting to read a .env file) mid-diagnosis of the mock-ipns-routing healthcheck, forcing a workaround without that file.
Subagent 68.1-16 ran a prohibited `git stash push` mid-task, leaving a stray stash entry that had to be manually identified and dropped during wave cleanup.
Session hit its usage/quota limit while the exit-gate agent was mid-triage, killing the agent and losing in-progress (uncommitted) fixture fixes that had to be manually diagnosed and recommitted.
Decision-coverage gate initially failed with an opaque parse error until the exact tag-placement rule (inside the bold ID group) was found by reading the parser source.
User-driven manual testing (logout/login navigation, text editor decrypt) repeatedly surfaced real bugs the automated e2e suite structurally couldn't reach due to serial-abort shadowing.
open_items: GAP-2 (cold-reload multi-level IPNS DFS timeout) — retry-budget fix applied but not yet reconfirmed by a clean full suite run before quota cutoff.
GAP-6 — REQ-4 itemName backfill is dead code post schema-cutover; needs an explicit feature-retirement or redesign decision, deliberately left unmarked in REQUIREMENTS/ROADMAP.
enumerateSharedSubtree (shared-move destination picker) still built on the now-empty share_keys fan-out and always returns an empty list — documented follow-up gap from 68.1-20, not yet fixed.
conflict-detection e2e failure persisted even after the 'adopt published state after every publish' fix (3cdf20e28) — root cause not yet found.
rotation-durability SC-4 e2e failure still unresolved at last check.
Round-2 phase verification reported gaps_found (3/5 success criteria) — phase 68.1 remains pending, further gap-closure planning needed.

Files uploaded to the dev vault before the fileReadKey seal fix landed have permanently mis-sealed parent refs and will keep failing to decrypt — flagged as data damage, not a code bug, no cleanup done.
Commits 17e4319a6 and 7209e8777 have parentheses in their subjects — flagged to keep out of the eventual PR title but not otherwise addressed.
